definitions.explanation: An informal, relatively relaxed group discussion, typically with several participants sharing their views on a topic. Common in magazines, television, and academic or professional settings.

examples.japanese: {座談会|ざだんかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
⟦{雑誌|ざっし}→雑誌：00686_zasshi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{座談会|ざだんかい}⟦{形式|けいしき}→形式：00211_keishiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{記事|きじ}→記事：00227_kiji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{掲載|けいさい}→掲載：08993_keisai⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: An article in round-table discussion format was published in the magazine.

examples.japanese: ⟦{専門家|せんもんか}→専門家：03088_senmonka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{招|まね}いた→招く：02425_maneku⟧{座談会|ざだんかい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦{活性化|かっせいか}→活性化：07563_kasseika⟧⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{活発|かっぱつ}→活発：13272_kappatsu⟧な⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦{交換|こうかん}→交換：02746_koukan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: At a round-table discussion with invited experts, a lively exchange of opinions on regional revitalization took place.

notes:
USAGE:
A common format in Japanese media, especially magazines and online publications, where several people (often experts or public figures) discuss a topic in a conversational, less formal tone than a symposium or academic panel. The results are often published as transcribed conversations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {座談会|ざだんかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧: to hold a round-table discussion
- {座談会|ざだんかい}⟦{形式|けいしき}→形式：00211_keishiki⟧: round-table format
- {座談会|ざだんかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}する→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧: to participate in a round-table discussion
- {座談会|ざだんかい}⟦{記事|きじ}→記事：00227_kiji⟧: round-table discussion article
